title: GATX Corporation Sets Date for 2025 Fourth-Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) will report 2025 fourth-quarter results prior to market open on Feb. 19, 2026. The Company expects to announce its quarterly dividend concurrently with earnings. GATX will host a conference call later that morning to review the results. Investors can access the call by telephone or via webcast as follows: Live Teleconference Date: Feb. 19, 2026 Time: 11 a.m. (Eastern Time) Domestic Dial-In: 1 (800) 715-9871 International Dial-In: 1 (646) 307-1963 Live Webcast: www.gatx.com To participate by phone, please dial in approximately 15 minutes prior to the start time and reference the GATX conference call. To listen via webcast, click the link on GATX’s homepage, www.gatx.com .
